title: What Home Buying Guide Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of home buying guide: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Buying a home: get pre-approved, budget beyond the mortgage (taxes, insurance, maintenance ~1-2%/year), and never waive inspection. The 28/36 rule keeps payments sane.

Why it matters: 28/36 rule: housing <= 28% of gross income; all debt <= 36% Down payments: 3-20%; 20% avoids PMI

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.
facts: Buying a home: get pre-approved, budget beyond the mortgage (taxes, insurance, maintenance ~1-2%/year), and never waive inspection. The 28/36 rule keeps payments sane.
28/36 rule: housing <= 28% of gross income; all debt <= 36%

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Home Buying Guide
summary: Start home buying guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Check credit; fix errors
2. Get pre-approved (not just pre-qualified)
3. Define needs vs wants + neighborhoods
4. Tour with a buyer's agent
5. Make offers with inspection contingency

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: The Numbers That Matter in Home Buying Guide
summary: Real figures behind home buying guide: costs, timelines, and benchmarks.
body:
The numbers:

- 28/36 rule: housing <= 28% of gross income; all debt <= 36%
- Down payments: 3-20%; 20% avoids PMI
- Closing costs: 2-5% of price
- Maintenance budget: 1-2% of home value/year
- Never skip the inspection ($300-$500 saves thousands)

Write these down. Decisions made with numbers beat decisions made with vibes — every time.

title: Home Buying Guide Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common home buying guide questions.
body:
Q: How much down?
A: 20% avoids PMI; 3-5% works with PMI or assistance programs.

Q: New build or resale?
A: Resale negotiates; new build warranties. Both need inspections.

Q: When to buy?
A: When you'll stay 5+ years and payments fit the 28% rule.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
